statement: Establish written procedures that make it possible to recall defective products from the market, and follow them.
quote: manufacturers must establish and follow written procedures to facilitate the recall of defective products from the market

statement: Where an OTC drug is approved in a new drug application, the manufacturer reports quality defects to FDA.
quote: Manufacturers of OTC drugs approved in a new drug application are required to report quality defects
condition: OTC drug approved in a new drug application

statement: Where an OTC drug is marketed without an approved application (monograph drug), the manufacturer, packer or distributor named on the label submits to FDA any report it receives of a serious adverse event associated with the drug when used in the United States.
quote: the manufacturer, packer, or distributor whose name appears on the label of an OTC drug without an approved application (i.e., OTC monograph drugs) must submit to FDA any report received of a serious adverse event associated with such drug when used in the United States
condition: named on the label of an OTC monograph drug; serious adverse event in the United States

statement: Establish and follow written procedures for periodically reviewing complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations of product discrepancies.
quote: manufacturers must establish and follow written procedures for periodically reviewing complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations of product discrepancies

statement: When investigating, review an appropriate number of batches, both approved and rejected, and, where applicable, the records for those batches, so that all product that may be affected is fully investigated and suitable follow-up action is taken.
quote: Firms must also review an appropriate number of batches, whether approved or rejected, and, where applicable, records associated with the batches, to ensure that all potentially affected product is thoroughly investigated and appropriate follow-up action is taken
condition: where applicable, records associated with the batches

statement: Voluntarily recall any drug that is defective or flawed if it could be hazardous to health.
quote: FDA expects that a firm will voluntarily recall a drug that is defective or flawed if it could be hazardous to health
condition: defect could be hazardous to health
